PORTFOLIO OS — COMPLETE PRODUCTION ARCHITECTURE REVIEW PACK

System Overview:
Portfolio OS is a local-first personal investment management and automated portfolio rebalancing system under a single-process, single-store architecture:
1. Java Core Node (Spring Boot 4.1.2 on Java 21/27):
   - Cryptographic append-only SQLite HMAC-SHA256 ledger (data/tax_ledger.db) with SHA-256 chain verification.
   - Unified HikariCP connection pool for event sourcing, market data (nav_history, benchmark_history), and rebalance trigger history.
   - Statutory Indian Income Tax Act FIFO lot matching engine (Section 112A LTCG with calendar-month holding periods, Section 112 non-equity LTCG, Section 50AA specified mutual funds, and Jan 31 2018 grandfathering FMV).
   - Policy v2.3 / v2.4 Rebalance Engine with water-filling allocation waterfall, drawdown arbitration, and ATH watermark tracking.
   - Self-contained Spring Boot HTTP REST API (port 8080) serving static Svelte 5 SPA directly from classpath.
2. Web Cockpit (Svelte 5 / Vite / Glassmorphic UI):
   - 3-tab cockpit: Executive Overview, Scheme Tax Lots with LTCG maturation countdown, and Rebalance & Capital Provenance Waterfall.
   - Local Quiet Mode privacy masking and Section 112A ITR-2 Schedule CG ZIP exporter.
3. Quant Tools (Python 3.12 On-Demand CLI):
   - Standalone CAS PDF and broker CSV parser invoked directly via ProcessBuilder on statement upload.
4. Automation & Reliability:
   - Systemd user service (portfolio-os-core.service) and automated hourly SQLite online VACUUM INTO backup (scripts/backup_ledger.sh).
